title.zh: 将布基农省 Pangantucan 市镇Langcataon描笼涯的Pangantucan国立中学的Langcataon附属校分离，单独改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Pangantucan National High School - Langcataon Annex in Barangay Langcataon, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon From the Pangantucan National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Langcataon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Langcataon của Trường Trung học Pangantucan Quốc gia tại Barangay Langcataon, Đô thị Pangantucan, Tỉnh Bukidnon khỏi Trường Trung học Pangantucan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Langcataon Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Langcataon ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pangantucan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Langcataon เทศบาล Pangantucan จังหวัด Bukidnon ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pangantucan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Langcataon แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Langcataon, Sekolah Menengah Pangantucan Nasional di Barangay Langcataon, Kotamadya Pangantucan, Provinsi Bukidnon dari Sekolah Menengah Pangantucan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Langcataon Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Langcataon, Sekolah Menengah Pangantucan Kebangsaan di Barangay Langcataon, Perbandaran Pangantucan, Wilayah Bukidnon daripada Sekolah Menengah Pangantucan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Langcataon Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Pangantucan National High School - Langcataon Annex in Barangay Langcataon, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon is hereby separated from the Pangantucan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Langcataon National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Pangantucan National High School - Langcataon Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Langcataon National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Langcataon National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Pangantucan National High School - Langcataon Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in this Official Gazette.
